verdict.rationale: Cerebras ships first-party SDKs: a Python package installed with `pip install --upgrade cerebras_cloud_sdk` in the official quickstart, and an official Node/TypeScript library on GitHub. The Node library gives server-side access to the REST API and adds an SDK-level TCP-warming mechanism to cut time-to-first-token. OpenAI API compatibility also lets developers use existing OpenAI SDKs by changing only the API key, base URL and model ID. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK reference documentation or coverage of languages beyond Python and Node, independent hands-on reports of using the official SDKs, and a published OpenAPI spec (probes of candidate paths returned 404).
